verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own docs describe public APIs. The CKS API creates, lists, updates and deletes managed Kubernetes clusters. The Inference API controls gateways, model deployments and capacity claims, using Bearer-token auth, multiple transport protocols, and generated clients in Go, Python, TypeScript and other languages. Programmatic access is extended by a Terraform provider, the FOCUS billing API (Public Preview), and API access tokens. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use, and a single unified API reference covering all products (e.g. storage and quotas management)
